source.description: OCaml binary-trees benchmark redistributed by Programming-Language-Benchmarks under its nested BSD-3-Clause benchmark license.

toolchain.name: OCaml + wasm_of_ocaml + Binaryen
toolchain.command: ocamlc -o binarytrees.byte bench/algorithm/binarytrees/1.ml; wasm_of_ocaml compile --enable wasi --effects=cps --opt=3 --no-source-map -o binarytrees.js binarytrees.byte; cp binarytrees.wasm stage/ocaml_binarytrees.wasm; ./scripts/prepare

description: OCaml binary-tree benchmark compiled directly to WasmGC, repeatedly allocating, traversing, and checking short-lived and long-lived object trees.
notes: The exact upstream OCaml source is compiled unchanged. Its nested binary-trees benchmark license is BSD-3-Clause; the containing Programming-Language-Benchmarks repository is MIT-licensed. wasm_of_ocaml is LGPL-2.1-or-later with a linking exception that permits distribution of linked executables under chosen terms. The generated JavaScript launcher is not used; tests execute the compiler's WASI Preview 1 module directly.
